# Capabilities

Ipê runs programs under a deny-by-default capability model. Every operation that touches an OS resource, crosses a trust boundary, or exercises non-determinism maps to exactly one capability axis. A program's capability set is the union over its transitively-reachable kernels; any axis not in that set is denied at the sandbox layer. The axes are declared once in the compiler's closed `Capability` enum and cannot be extended without a source change.

## Boundary classes

- [OS resource](#os-resource)
- [Non-determinism](#non-determinism)
- [Native crossing](#native-crossing)

## OS resource

| Wire name | Grants |
|-----------|--------|
| `network` | Outbound or inbound network access (HTTP client/server, WebSocket, email send). |
| `filesystem` | Reading or writing the filesystem (files, directories, config files). |
| `database` | Structured database access (SQL queries, migrations, row decoders). |
| `env` | Reading or writing process environment variables and argv. |
| `subprocess` | Spawning or controlling a child process. |

## Non-determinism

| Wire name | Grants |
|-----------|--------|
| `clock` | Reading wall-clock or monotonic time, or sleeping / firing on a timer. |
| `random` | Drawing non-deterministic randomness (RNG, random tokens, UUIDs). |

## Native crossing

| Wire name | Grants |
|-----------|--------|
| `native-ffi` | Crossing into native Rust. code — the program's true capability set cannot be inferred from Ipê alone. |
| `ffi-raw` | Crossing into native Rust. code through an author-asserted signature rather than an inspected binding (always accompanies NativeFfi). |
| `unsafe` | Importing an Ipe.<M>.Unsafe submodule — the program contains a value the compiler could not prove safe. |
| `custom-element` | Shipping browser custom-element JS that runs in the page with full DOM authority; the served bytes are SRI-pinned and CSP-constrained. |
| `js-port:geolocation` | Accessing navigator.geolocation — the device's location. |
| `js-port:clipboard` | Reading or writing the system clipboard via navigator.clipboard. |
| `js-port:notification` | Showing a system notification via the Notification API. |
| `js-port:storage` | Client-side persistence via localStorage / sessionStorage / IndexedDB. |
| `js-port:vibration` | Activating the vibration actuator via navigator.vibrate. |
| `js-port:share` | Invoking the platform share sheet via navigator.share. |
| `js-port:battery` | Reading battery status via navigator.getBattery. |
| `js-port:network-info` | Reading network-information hints via navigator.connection. |
| `js-port:file` | Opening a native file picker and reading the chosen file via the File API (FileReader.readAsDataURL). |
| `js-port:camera` | Capturing a photo via the device camera (mobile) or an image file picker (desktop) using a <input capture> element and the File API. |
| `js-port:raw` | Exchanging data with hand-rolled page JS over an uncharacterised port (Js.send / Js.subscribe with author-written JS). |
